item.title: Editor Welcome
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Welcome to the Loreto Hockey Club website

Support Info

I handle all the WordPress (CMS) updates, plugin and theme updates in the background. I take care of backups and website security. I also take care of the server - updates and caching.

Your Support Package runs until 01/02/2021

Good to know

Your website domain is registered with Let's Host via loretohockeyclub@gmail.com

Your website files are hosted with Cloudways via loretohockeyclub@gmail.com

Fixtures on the site are controlled through Google Calendar. Each team has it's own calendar, and the calendars are displayed on the website using a plugin. The fixtures can be lumped in together (on the home page, or fixtures page) or separated out (for a team page for example).

What can we do on the site?

Your logon gives you limited access to the website. We want to allow you to update information without breaking any of the layout!  So, with your login you can:

  • Add new Posts (news, newsletters etc) - via the admin panel (where you are now)
  • Amend any existing content via the front-end live editor

item.content:encoded:
Web and video solutions to move and inspire

Doghouse Media is an independently female-owned and operated, creative digital agency based in Dublin.

We foster lasting relationships with our clients, helping them to shape their digital outlook and realise their goals quickly.

See Our Work

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Introduction

This Privacy Policy governs the manner in which this website - doghousemedia.ie - collects, uses, maintains and discloses information collected from users of this website. This privacy policy applies only to this website and the services offered online by this website. This Privacy Policy will be updated from time to time.

About this website

This website is owned by Doghouse Media Ltd, a web agency based in Ireland. Doghouse Media is a controller of personal data for the purposes of the General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”), which governs the collection, storage and processing of personal data and is effective in Ireland from 25 May 2018.

Personal Data processed

We respect your right to privacy and will maintain any personal information we hold about you in accordance with GDPR. We do not sell or distribute your personal information to third parties for the purpose of allowing them to market to you. We collect personal data relating to you for reasons of medical diagnosis, provision of healthcare, management of healthcare and ensuring quality of healthcare.

Non-personal Data processed

We may collect non-personal identification information about Users whenever they interact with our website. Non-personal identification information may include (but is not limited to) the browser type, IP Address, the type of device, screen size, and technical information about users method of connection to our website, such as OS, the ISP used and other similar information.

Cookies

This website uses cookies to distinguish you from other users of our website. This helps us to provide you with a positive and relevant experience when you browse our website and also allows us to improve our site and its functionality. Web browser place cookies on user's hard drive for record-keeping purposes and sometimes to track information about them. A user may choose to set their web browser to refuse cookies. If they do so, note that some parts of the website may not function as intended. For detailed information on the cookies we use and the purposes for which we use them please see our Cookie Policy. We process your personal data for the following purposes:
  • Conducting statistical analysis
  • Improving user experience
This website contains links to other websites which you can choose to click on to visit. We are not responsible for the content or cookie collection practises on other websites.

Retention of Data

We will retain your personal data and maintain a record of your payments and other interactions with us for as long as we are required for financial reporting purposes. We will also retain your personal data for the purposes of providing access to our website and related services to you and generally as required by law or applicable regulation and for the exercise or defence of legal claims (generally for 7 years).

Your rights as a user of this website

You have the following rights, in certain circumstances and subject to applicable exemptions, in relation to your personal data:
  • the right to access the personal data that we hold about you, and other information about our processing of that personal data
  • the right to require us to rectify any inaccuracies in your personal data
  • the right to require us to erase your personal data
  • the right to request that we no longer process your personal data for particular purposes
  • the right to object to our use of your personal data or the way in which we process it
  • the right to request us to transmit your personal data to a third party, or to give you a copy of it so that you can transmit it to a third party, where technically feasible You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Irish Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (info@dataprotection.ie) or your local supervisory authority if you consider that the processing of your personal data infringes GDPR.

Contacting us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, the practices, or your dealings with this website, please contact us using the contact details outlined on our contact page.

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
About Us

We're a small Dublin based team with a genuine passion for creativity. We have been in the digital business since 2013 and everything we do is backed by solid experience and proven results.

How we work

For us, every relationship is built on trust and honesty. Our goal is to carry these relationships forward through top notch delivery and support.

Before we start on your project, we'll engage with the key individuals in your business to gain an understanding of your objectives and what you are looking to achieve.

Our design processes keeps those people involved, engaged and informed throughout the design, build and life of your project.

What's our mission here at Doghouse Media

Our mission is to make you stand out from the rest, be it through a gorgeously designed website you can update yourself to a fast moving effective online promo video you can use as part of of an effective marketing campaign.

There we are - meet the team

Emma Walkin

DIRECTOR

Emma heads our media production and handles overall operations.

Alan Higgison

CREATIVE LEAD

Alan works as creative lead in the media side of our business.

Susan Ryan

OPERATIONS DIRECTOR

Susan has over 20 years experience in IT in Ireland and the UK, her roles have ranged from programming and consultancy to Project Management.

item.title: Web Development
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Website Design & Development

Our goal is to build your visibility and ensure your website keeps working for you long after it has gone live.

We use a project-based approach, employing a Graphic Designer to ensure a clean and consistent design that reflects your brand strategy and visual identity.

Enquire about Web Development

What's part of our development services?

Design and Development

In a world where everything increasingly looks the same, you need to stand out. We craft bespoke designed websites by combining technical skills with creative solutions.If you're looking for an off the shelf template, look elsewhere - we firmly believe that if you are going to do something you gotta do it right!

Mobile Responsive

A responsive performing website is key - not only to your user's experience but to how your site performs on search.Take confidence knowing your site will not only look great, but will convert across all devices.

A truly flexible CMS

Take back control. Be it a brochure site or a full blown e-Commerce site we want you to be able to update easily and securely, whenever you want.We start with a tailored dashboard at login and easy to access video guides which walk you through what you need to know.

SEO ready to go

Search Engine Optimisation is an on-going task, but it starts off early in the design process rather than being added in later.We'll leverage a baseline approach in the design phase, ensuring your website is perfectly positioned to implement a winning strategy at go-live.

GDPR compliancy

We'll work with you on your Privacy Policy and Cookie statement, implementing a Cookie Management tool if one is needed.Rest assured, all our data collection forms are GDPR compliant

Speed Speed Speed

If your website isn't optimised for speed potential customers will loose patience and search engines will penalize you. We'll advise you on Cloud Hosting options, caching, and CDN - at a minimum building your website leanly, ensuring optimum experience for every visitor.

Enquire about Web Development

High Level

Learndash

Take your website further

e-Commerce

We work with both Shopify and WooCommerce platforms - we'll integrate payment gateways and shipping options, setting up your product pages, and customizing your store to fit your brand.Sell physical or digital products, manage orders and inventory, and offer discounts and promotions to your customers. 

Online Course

Custom delivery of eLearning education courses or online training programs. We use Learn Dash but can integrate with most LMS solutions.We'll customize your course pages and user dashboard to fit your brand. Create and sell courses on any subject, manage user progress and completion, and offer quizzes and certificates to learners.

Membership & Subscription

We'll create a platform for you to offer exclusive content, courses, or products to your subscribers. We can also help you set up a recurring billing system, automated emails, and member management tools to ensure a seamless user experience.

Donations and Payments

Process donations and payments using a tailored solution which integrates seamlessly with your payment gateway of choice.We utilize the powerful, tried and tested Donation platform GiveWP which handles recurring payments, once off donations and extensive donor management.

Integration with your Office Solutions

We use tools like Zapier and custom form building to integrate your website with your CRM, Booking software and most common management systems. The sky really is the limit here.

Events platforms

Create and promote in-person or online events on your website. Ticket selling, attendee management, recurring events, Zoom integration and everything you would expect to run your event booking seamlessly. 

It doesn't stop there. Let's scale it, let's grow it...

Our relationship with you begins as soon as your site goes live. You take care of business - we'll take care of your website.

Our Website Care Plans provide not only peace of mind, but also support for any technical issues that may arise with your website. Focus on your business, not the tedious tasks of backups, security updates and troubleshooting.

If e-Commerce is your thing we'll support you with services such as strategy, content creation, code optimisation, Google Analytics reports, Google Business Profile optimization and monthly consultation calls.

Website Growth Plans

A quick glance at some recent development work

See More

Website Project Enquiry

This is the fastest way to get your Web Development project up and running - fill out this form and we will get in touch with you shortly. "*" indicates required fields
Step 1 of 5 20%

Purpose

This is your opportunity to tell us why you need a website and what the website should achieve. The more information you give us here, the better the solution we will be able to provide. Ignore any questions that are not relevant

Business Snapshot

What Are We Doing?

Give us your main reasons for needing a new website.

It's helpful to set SMART goals as it keeps all of us on the same page and moving in the same direction. IE: Goals that are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound.

With this in mind, what are the top 5 business needs of your new website?

EG: 20% increase in sales in 6 months, 30% increase in membership this year, reduce admin costs by 15% in 3 months

Who Are We Doing This For?

EG: research product information, get contact details, ask questions about services, pricing

Design Concept

What Does Success Look Like?

item.title: Media Production
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Media to move and inspire your audience

Our goal is to make you look your best, to inspire and to compel your audience to take action!

From workshopping the initial concept, filming and post production, to the optimum way to share your message - we'll guide you every step of the way.

Exceptional content will get you the results you need

Whether you are running a digital marketing campaign, creating eLearning courses, making ads for web or just telling a story, video is the key to an effective communications strategy. We focus on the below key areas.

Social media shorts

How do you cut through the noise? You've got milli-seconds to get it right and beat the scroll.The key to social media video production is evoking emotion in your audience and doing it quickly!

Promotional + VBC's

We create content that engages and converts. Your customers are more likely to buy / donate / engage with your brand after viewing a video. Video Business Cards

Live Event streaming

From interviews, to event coverage we have the experience to guide you through whatever project lies ahead.

Aeriel coverage

Incredible footage from above using latest state of the art drone technology and fully qualified and experienced drone operators.

Corporate Communications

Keep on message and bring your idea to life with an engaging and strategically designed video.

Instructional / Training

We have a track record of producing training videos of the highest-quality, we have produced content for Lego, the Irish Red Cross and Ted Baker.

A quick glance at some past work

item.content:encoded:
Web and video solutions to move and inspire

Doghouse Media is an independently female-owned and operated, creative digital agency based in Dublin.

We foster lasting relationships with our clients, helping them to shape their digital outlook and realise their goals quickly.

See Our Work

Trusted By

Take the next step and transform your online profile

With ever decreasing attention spans you've got mere seconds to engage your customers and stop the scroll!
Unlock the power of video marketing with short, snappy, punchy online promo's. About us

Take a look at some of our past projects

Get your digital game on and stand out from the rest

See Our Work

Media Production

From strategy to execution - creative solutions from a creative team.

View Service

Web Development

We create beautiful websites using clean and consistent design that reflects  your brand

View Service

Digital Services

A full range of services - Lead generation, Newsletter campaign management, CRM integrations and GDPR auditing.

View Service

item.title: Digital Services
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Digital Services

We have 20 plus years experience in the IT industry in Ireland which means we're perfectly placed to handle a number of your digital needs, from digital communications right through to GDPR auditing.

Get in touch with us to set up a 30 minute strategy call and see if we're the right for you.

See Our Work

n8n

Go High Level

What digital services do we provide?

CRM integration

Get your website talking to your office systems and make the most of seamless connectivity between your customer relationship management software and other third-party applications.

Email Marketing

We have extensive experience with Highlevel and Mailchimp platforms and handle several Lists and Campaigns on behalf of our customers..

AI Support bots

Advanced Conversational AI solutions that leverage artificial intelligence to automate customer interactions across various platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, and even your website. This innovative tool enhances customer engagement, improves response times, and provides a seamless user experience.

Workflow Automation

Streamlines your business processes by automating repetitive tasks, improving efficiency, and reducing manual errors. By integrating High Level into your operations, we help you enhance productivity, manage client interactions more effectively, and ensure seamless workflow management across your business.

Zapier configuration

Zapier is a tool that allows end users to integrate the web applications they use. If you are looking into configuring automation in your workflow get in touch.

SEO auditing

A website audit is the first place to start if you feel  your website is underperforming. We'll analyze your site to identify SEO errors, keyword opportunities, and let you know what the competition is doing.

Consultancy for Studio creatives

We work with some of Ireland's top creatives in this field and have extensive experience consulting in Workflow practises and CRM integration with systems like VSCO. Talk to us about a process audit to kick things off.

Lead Generation

Turn your website into a marketing machine while you get on with day to day business. We'll use cutting-edge conversion optimization tactics and features to get you there. Take online bookings, generate leads, send out promotional email campaigns - keep your customers engaged and happy.

Have a project? Let's talk.

item.content:encoded:
Website Growth Plans

Enjoy peace of mind knowing your website is in our capable hands.
‍
The corner-stone of your digital success starts with your online visibility. Leave it with us and focus on your business. Security, Performance, 24/7 monitoring, Backups and lots more included. See Our Work

Complete website management

Our Growth Plans are customised to fit the unique needs of your website. High-traffic e-commerce or appointment-based sites require extra attention. With all our plans, you can rest assured that we've got you covered in these essential areas...

01

item.title: SEO Packages Dublin
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Jump ahead with our SEO Expertise

Increase your website traffic and leads organically.

You may own a beautifully looking, well functioning website but if it is buried deep down the search results and your clients can't find you online, you might as well not exist!

Set up a Call

What's part of our SEO services?

Website Audit

How your website is built and how its running are crucial to improving your search rankings. The Web Audit is your starting point with us if you have an exiting website. We evaluate and provide you with a detailed audit report that specifies key areas of improvement.

Local SEO - Google Business Profile

Local business providers get ahead of the rest by optimising a GBP profile.Appear on Google Maps in local search and start getting leads in fast. We take care of setup for new accounts, audits, content and ongoing maintenance for existing GBP profiles.

On page SEO / site optimisation

An SEO strategy will only work if technical aspects of your website meet key requirements. We'll assess everything from Page Titles to Headings to Images to Navigation and website Copy. We'll cover it all. 

Keyword & competitor research

We'll work to uncover keywords that are highly relevant to both you and your audience so that you're well-positioned on Google when you need to be found.

GDPR compliancy

We'll work with you on your Privacy Policy and Cookie statement, implementing a Cookie Management tool if one is needed.Rest assured, all our data collection forms are GDPR compliant

Speed Speed Speed

If your website isn't optimised for speed potential customers will loose patience and search engines will penalize you. We'll advise you on Cloud Hosting options, caching, and CDN - at a minimum building your website leanly, ensuring optimum experience for every visitor.

Citation and link building

Your Business Name, Address and Phone Number (NAP) need to be consistent across the web. We'll run through an audit of your online profile and start adding you to the sites and directories you need to be on.

Content Creation

The key to content is quality - your audience will shy away from clickbait or bland and uninformative copy. Our local Content Writers are on hand to assist with both website copy, and as part of a longer term content publishing strategy.

What you can expect of from our services?

No-one can promise you a high ranking in a short period of time.
If they do, run a mile.

Getting Google to trust and rank your website takes time and that's why all of our Plans work off a 6 month minimum period.

Growth Accelerators

You have an existing website but the phone isn't ringing and not enough business is being generated. It can be confusing trying to decide where to turn to next. Start with a Web Audit - we'll go through your site with a fine tooth-comb and find the weak points.

Web Audit

Get Started

SEO Recurring Plans

Whether you are going after local business or targeting nationally, our SEO experts can tailor ​a campaign to attract more customers and generate more leads for your business.

Get Started

It doesn't stop there. Let's scale it, let's grow it...

Our relationship with you begins as soon as your site goes live. You take care of business - we'll take care of your website.

Our Website Care Plans provide not only peace of mind, but also support for any technical issues that may arise with your website. Focus on your business, not the tedious tasks of backups, security updates and troubleshooting.

If e-Commerce is your thing we'll support you with services such as strategy, content creation, code optimisation, Google Analytics reports, Google Business Profile optimization and monthly consultation calls.

item.title: Website for Photographer
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
A beautifully designed website is essential for every creative. Finding a balance between a website that generates leads and one which showcases the artist's work can be an additional challenge. With Nick's website the goal was to get it to stand out in a market saturated by over-used, bland photography templates which make every other photography site look like the next one. Standing out was essential. The key to the redesign was the Nick O'Keeffe brand itself. We worked with design partner Kay at Patterns on a new logo, typography, palette and branding rules for the business marketing pack and the website itself. We set to work on the website design, website copy and tone. Design and copy were agreed, the final stage was to develop the bespoke design itself.

Requirements

A bespoke CMS client interface. We used WordPress.
  • CRM integration and Lead Capture
  • Article section
  • Editable pricing page
  • Media galleries, video

Taking it further

The legacy website had little showing on Google rankings. We devised a content plan a technical strategy to get the new website rankings moving in the right direction. We identified and executed easier ranking wins but devised a a longer term approach which involved incorporating the Photographer's portfolio as part of a content strategy focused on the shoot venues themselves.
  • Content Planning (keyword research, competitor research, content strategy)
  • On site SEO Audit and maintenance
  • Google My Business overhaul and maintenance
  • Link building strategy
  • Social media posting calendar

item.title: Networking website for University
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Our remit
  • Development of a website for students in the UCD Aspire Network
  • The website must only be open to students past and present
  • Logo and Design
  • Support

Project main features

The website was to act as an informational hub for students past and present - a closed social network if you like. We employed a number of tools to achieve this:
  • Student Logins, Profile and CV editing
  • Bulletin boards and private messaging
  • Events and ticket booking
  • News updates
We built the site on WordPress, utilizing full functionality from BuddyPress, allowing students to take control of their profiles, browse other user's profiles and interact on a range of topics on the Bulletin Board. The Programme were able to login themselves and create Events, allow students to sign up to these events and to publish news stories of interest to the Community.

item.title: Online Portfolio for Irish Artist
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Aisling McEntee Walsh is an artist based in Dublin, Ireland. item.title: Website for Medical Professional
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Dr Kavanagh runs a busy specialised clinic in Galway City and is a client of ours - we also run his dotmd.ie website, an annual medical conference which has grown year on year since 2014. His requirements were
  1. Website Design
  2. Logo redraw
  3. Web Development of a CMS allowing easy updates
  4. Online Payments form
  5. Online Repeat Prescription form submission

Our process to execute this project

We enlisted our Design Partner at Patterns to help on the design of this project. Color Palette, Typography and iconography were sketched up on Figma and approved by the client who wanted 'a very simple, but functional website'. From a development point of view the following notable functionality was provided:
  • Allow Patients to pay invoices online. We integrated the payment form with the Stripe Payment gateway
  • Allow existing Patients to submit Repeat Prescription requests online
  • Allow Dr Kavanagh make simple updates himself using the CMS, including adding news items and video
The resulting site is simple but eye-catching. Subtle icon movement and some smooth fading animations are leveraged but not overdone. For Dr Kavanagh the website needed to be accessible to all and above all else 'just work'.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: A website to accept payments, take appointment enquiries and provide important patient information.

item.title: Online shop for Beauty Salon
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
This was a hugely rewarding project - launching the website and online shop for a boutique salon in the centre of Kilkenny. We advised the client on
  1. Logo design, branding (through our design parnter friends at Patterns)
  2. Website Design - a bespoke design was developed
  3. CMS - WordPress. A bespoke design was developed and implemented.
  4. E-Commerce - full integration with Shopify
The website was built using a bespoke design and theme based on branding guidelines from the designer. Shopify products and checkout are fully integrated with the website, meaning the client can make full use of the Shopify app to manage products and orders.

Taking it further

We advised the client on how to add more visibility to the brand and a plan was implemented to get the Google Business Profile optimised and increase local searches from Google. Local map pack rankings have increased dramatically in the 6 months since go-live.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: All the flexibility of WordPress, combined with the rock-solid e-commerce platform Shopify

item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie

We have been with basis.point since the start of their journey in 2014. The Charity was set up by the Funds Industry following the crash in 2007. In 2021 a complete redesign of the site was needed, and it was the perfect time to get the site working more seamlessly with their CRM. We led the redesign and redevelopment, our remit included

We looked at design first and foremost - the current site looked a little stale and too corporate, we wanted to move away from this and put the charity beneficiaries front and center. The website needed to quickly get across it's message and make it easy for Patrons and new volunteers to sign on

item.title: Website for Journalist and Author
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Muiris Houston is a well known medical journalist, writer and Health Strategist - he has written weekly for the Irish Times om health matters for over 20 years. Muiris approached us in advance of the release of his biography on the renowned Irish psychiatrist, writer and broadcaster Anthony Clare - he needed a website to help publicize the launch and provide background information on his interests and writings. Our remit from Muiris was
  1. Rework of logo
  2. Design, Typography, Colour Palette and graphics on the site
  3. Development of the website and CMS
  4. Promotion of the book.

Our process to execute this project

We employed WordPress for the website CMS and provided training. The website features
  • The ability to amend content from the front end
  • Add news items / articles of interest
  • Bio information on the author
  • Information about the book and how to purchase
A very simple design layout and typography was employed and a bespoke build undertaken. Our goal was to make the site load as quickly as possible and provide the owner with the ability to control the site content with as much ease as possible.

item.title: Sports Club websites
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
We manage the websites of two of Ireland's most well known Hockey Clubs - Pembroke Wanderers and Loreto Hockey Club. Both websites were designed at implemented by us. When it comes to organic search there are no better performing club websites in Ireland than the Pembroke Wanderers and Loreto websites. This is no accident, there are specific reasons these websites perform so well on search
  1. Both sites were leanly developed, using bespoke designed developer templates. No cheap off the shelf Themes here.
  2. Content is front and centre and regularly updated by the Club.
  3. Best practise on-page SEO techniques
  4. Software regularly maintained and tweaked
  5. Engagement from users - both sites have a below average bounce rate.
  6. Effective social media strategy from both Clubs

Our process to execute these projects

We turned to WordPress and developed a bespoke Theme for each website. We employed custom fields to allow quick and easy updates of pages and posts.
  • Fixtures are integrated fully with Google Calendar
  • Easy to use CMS, add news items, Galleries etc
  • Easy to update front end

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: We developed and support websites belonging to two of Ireland's most well know Hockey Clubs - Pembroke Wanderers and Loreto Hockey Club.

item.title: Promotional video for Events Venue
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded: How do you pick a wedding venue when you live in another country and can't get home? Or do some in depth research on a location for your event in the middle of a pandemic? Covid has forced businesses to re-evaluate how they reach their customers, leading us all to adapt to a new norm. And this will mean in many cases that there's no going back. We've come now to expect that our favourite boutique will continue to accept online orders, that our local take-away will deliver at the touch of a button, and that when it comes to researching activities and events we can do so from the comfort of a chair at home. Cloughjordan House is a unique family run venue in Co. Tipperary, it's strength is in its charm of character and it's people. But it's difficult to get this across in an email, on a brochure or on a website 'About Us' page. During the pandemic Sarah and Peter, owners of CJH realised that video was the key tool missing from their marketing strategy.  Our job was to put their story on camera and bring it all together in an engaging and informative way. Aside from being great search engine fodder, video is the medium consumers are now switching to. It’s engaging, easy to digest, and easy to share with others. You get a fuller insight into the topic being explored, and in this case, the warmth and genuine family welcome Cloughjordan seamlessly offers was perfectly demonstrated. Check out the short promo below, we also accompanied it with a series of 60 second Instagram stings showcasing different aspects the House has to offer.

item.title: Irish Charity - online donation platform
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Loreto Rumbek is a Primary and Secondary school located in South Sudan. The school was started by Sr. Orla Treacy in 2008 and from small beginnings now serves a much wider community through a newly built Healthcare Centre, while providing a much needed place of education and sanctuary for girls aged 5-20. In 2014 Susan met with Directory Orla Treacy and together formulated a donation and marketing strategy for the school. This was an incredible opportunity to work on the Project from the very beginning. We immediately got to work on
  1. Branding Pack - a logo, colour pallet and typography were designed.
  2. New website
  3. Online Donation platform added to the website
  4. Email Newsletter strategy devised and implemented
  5. Social media setup

Taking it further - Promotional videos

Emma and Alan travelled to South Sudan in November 2021 armed with cameras and drone. The wonderful work and vibrancy of this amazing place was desperately missing. The schools and Healthcare Centre rely heavily on donations through their website and wider support from supporters around the world. This is the first in a series of films we are producing to highlight everyday life in the school, how donations are making a difference, and of course an opportunity for a thank you from the Students and Teachers to those who have contributed to keeping this hugely successful Programme going. Additionally our brief was to build up a library of Photography for use on the Charity website, social media and donor supports. Alan and Emma took some superb photos, which our good friend Elaine Barker compiled and edited. Video benefits
  • Video is an instantly more engaging method of communicating with existing and new Donors
  • Made for sharing on social media
  • Marked increase in conversion rates from email

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Creation of a brand, website and online donation platform for Loreto Rumbek - a school in South Sudan for girls

item.title: National Orthopaedic Hospital - promo film
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Project Overview

In 2024 we had the privilege of creating a 4-minute promotional video for the National Orthopaedic Hospital, Cappagh in Dublin. This video was showcased at their flagship fundraising event in Dublin in spring 2024, a lunch event that gathered key stakeholders and supporters.

Project Details

Our video featured in-depth interviews with the CEO of the hospital, the Clinical Director, and two patients who shared their personal experiences and testimonials. To provide a comprehensive view of the hospital’s facilities, we captured detailed footage of various operational areas including the operating rooms, recovery areas, and physiotherapy rooms.

Client Feedback

The video received an overwhelmingly positive response from the client, highlighted by a testimonial from Susan Foley, Communications Manager at the National Orthopaedic Hospital, Cappagh:
"Having collaborated with numerous videographers over the years, I can honestly say that Doghouse Media stand out for their exceptional professionalism, creativity, and quality. They don't just meet the brief; they think beyond it, ensuring flawless execution and powerful storytelling. They elevated our brief, investing long hours eliciting rich content from interviewees and capturing detailed B-roll footage to complement the narrative. I would not hesitate to recommend Doghouse Media, and I look forward to our next collaboration."

Conclusion

This project was a testament to our commitment to delivering high-quality, engaging content that not only meets but exceeds our clients’ expectations. We are proud of the work we did for the National Orthopaedic Hospital, Cappagh and look forward to future collaborations.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Patient stories and promotional film for Ireland's National Orthopaedic Hospital

item.title: Booking platform and e-Commerce for Skincare Clinic
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
Merrion Medical Aesthetics are a busy aesthetic clinic in Toronto who also sell premium health and skincare products through their website. They engaged us to consolidate their digital stack and align the website with their operational needs. Our focus was on platform consultancy, a workable SEO strategy, and the evaluation and integration of CRM and booking software to support online appointments, automated SMS/email reminders, and a smooth client experience.

Key Contributions:

  • Platform Consultancy & Roadmapping:
    • Ran requirements workshops covering online bookings, practitioner schedules, multi-location support, product sales (where relevant), and reporting.
    • Evaluated platform options and integration patterns (native apps vs. API/webhooks) to unify content, bookings, and customer data.
  • SEO Strategy & Technical Foundations:
    • Built an SEO plan around services and location: keyword mapping, site architecture, and internal linking.
    • Implemented on-page standards (titles, meta descriptions, headings, alt text) and structured data (Organization/LocalBusiness, Product/Service, FAQ where applicable).
    • Sitemap submission, robots directives, canonical strategy, performance and image optimisation, and local SEO signals (location pages, reviews).
  • CRM & Booking Software Consultancy & Integration:
    • Selected and integrated a booking system supporting real-time availability, deposits, and multi-practitioner calendars.
    • Connected CRM for the full client lifecycle: intake forms and consents, segmentation, and data-compliant communications.
    • Configured automated reminders and follow-ups: SMS/email appointment confirmations, reschedule/cancellation flows, and post-visit sequences.
    • Enabled two-way calendar sync for staff and basic dashboarding for bookings, show rate, and repeat visits.
  • Website Design & Build:
    • Built a clear, mobile-first site structure with decisive calls to book appointments or browse the online store
    • Used reusable content blocks to keep updates efficient, with attention to accessibility and trust signals (bios, credentials, affiliations).
  • Product & Catalogue Setup (where applicable):
    • Structured product lines, variants, and content for consistency across the catalogue and alignment with service pages.
    • Standardised imagery, specs, and SEO fields to improve discovery and conversion.

Outcome:

The clinic now has a unified platform that supports online bookings with automated SMS and email reminders, a connected CRM for compliant client communications, and an SEO framework designed to improve local visibility and conversions. The result is a cleaner operational workflow and a smoother experience for patients booking online.

item.title: Orthondontist website
item.dc:creator: susan@doghousemedia.ie
item.content:encoded:
From zero visibility to #1 in the Galway market. Galway Braces is a specialist clinic known for excellent patient care, but they lacked a digital presence to match. Doghouse Media was brought in to build a professional home for the practice and, more importantly, to ensure they could actually be found by patients online.

The Challenge

Despite their clinical reputation, Galway Braces had no search engine ranking for their core services. In a competitive local market, they were essentially invisible to new patients searching for orthodontic care in the west of Ireland.

What We Did

Modern Branding & Design: We gave the practice a fresh, professional look. Using clean layouts and high-quality photography, we ensured the site felt both clinical and welcoming for parents and adult patients alike. We introduced professional staff photography to ensure the digital experience felt as warm and approachable as a face-to-face visit to the practice. Web Development: We built a fast, mobile-friendly website that makes it easy for users to understand their treatment options—from a child’s first assessment at age 8 to discreet adult braces. Search Engine Success: We implemented a focused SEO strategy designed to dominate the local market. We moved away from industry jargon and focused on the terms real patients use when looking for help.

The Result

The impact was game-changing. Having previously had no search engine ranking at all, Galway Braces now ranks #1 in Google for their primary search terms, including "Orthodontist Galway" and "Braces Galway". The practice has successfully transitioned from a hidden gem to the most visible orthodontic specialist in the region, seeing a significant increase in direct inquiries and new patient consultations.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Strategic Branding, Digital Transformation, and Market-Leading SEO
